text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
Yawning during training of all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I tucked myself in properly, but...
I had a bit of a bad dream.
choice_data_list: What kind of dream did you have?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "Well, Gold Ship-san shoved me into a rocket..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Please, no more.
Just remembering it sends chills down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Even though our break just ended,
my heart feels so heavy."
